SUMMARY
Spacious Three-Bedroom Mid-Terraced Home on Lincoln Road, Portsmouth

DESCRIPTION
Spacious Three-Bedroom Mid-Terraced Home on Lincoln Road, Portsmouth

Situated on the popular and well-connected Lincoln Road in Portsmouth, this generously proportioned three-bedroom mid-terraced house offers a fantastic combination of space, versatility and convenience. With two separate reception rooms, an extended kitchen, two WCs, a spacious loft and three good-sized bedrooms, the property is ideally suited to families, first-time buyers or those looking for a home with plenty of room to grow.

Upon entering, the property offers two separate reception rooms, providing excellent flexibility for modern living. Whether used as a comfortable lounge and separate dining room, family room, home office or playroom, the additional reception space gives the house a real sense of versatility.
To the rear is an extended kitchen, offering practical space for everyday cooking and entertaining. The kitchen also benefits from a useful utility area/cupboard, providing additional storage and space for household appliances. A modern downstairs bathroom completes the ground floor.

Upstairs, there are three good-sized bedrooms, offering comfortable accommodation for a growing family, guests or those working from home. The first floor also benefits from a convenient separate WC, while the particularly spacious loft provides excellent potential for storage.

Close to plenty of local amenities, a moment away from the train station and great schools, this is ideal for families.
